sketches.mechanism: IEEE-754 NaN is the only value for which strict equality is not reflexive: NaN !== NaN.
sketches.resonance: A self can be present and still fail the test of being identical to itself.

sketches.mechanism: A weak reference does not retain its object and is automatically set to nil when the last strong reference leaves scope.
sketches.resonance: What is held without possession disappears the moment the living hold ends.

sketches.mechanism: A return in a finally block executes after and suppresses the value returned by the try block.
sketches.resonance: The last obligation can overwrite the promise already made.
